model.designDecision: New complete Ascension-only form and insight; no comparator profile is imported. All four native routes use this identity; Cleric remains Divination and the other native routes remain Conjuration.
model.admission: Self only; no recipient conversion. A live effective alignment resolver supplies independent Order and Moral axes after legitimate Lock/Anchor/protection. Preserve underlying alignment histories. Undefined/protected is not Neutral.

body.sizeAnatomy: retain original occupied bounds, anatomy, limbs, hands, mass, physical support and senses
body.appearance: visible energy form; appearance never reveals an otherwise protected axis
body.hp: retain exact current/max HP, Wounds, zero/death and all injury history; no second bar, refill or replacement life
body.equipment: all real equipment remains worn/carried at its current stable attachment; focus/armor/capacity unchanged
body.basePermissions: ordinary movement, physical collision, attacks and lawful casting remain; no flight, incorporeality, immunity, planar access or extra turn

moralAxis.undefinedOrProtected: energy strike unavailable; ordinary actions remain

energyStrike.cost: one actual Action; not a spell cast
energyStrike.target: one perceived creature within60ft and clear LoE
energyStrike.resolution: one spell attack using the owning cast's legal attack bonus
energyStrike.damage: 4d10 of the current permitted Moral-axis type; ordinary target mitigation and dealer attribution apply
energyStrike.dealer: the transformed actor, not a separate creature

insight.cost: one actual Action; not a new cast or extra RP cost
insight.target: one perceived creature within120ft and clear LoE
insight.output: Only that target's permitted current effective Order/Moral axes, each with as-of time; no underlying conduct, private memories, alignment cause or genealogy
insight.protection: Covered/unknown axis yields identical No information available; do not reveal which reason. Never force a save or create public sigils borrowed from another spell
insight.cadence: one query per actual Action; no passive refresh

lifecycle.printedInstantaneous: initiation only; finite continuing form is a NEW explicit spell-local interpretation, not a native source claim
lifecycle.starts: legal commitment; interrupted cast ends its attempted concentration with paid costs intact
lifecycle.axisUpdates: reevaluate immediately before each affected action/check; changes remove old modifiers before adding new ones
lifecycle.ending: concentration loss/incapacity/death/eligible dispel/replacement/elapsed deadline ends the form; no HP/history reset
lifecycle.suppression: covered ongoing expression inactive, clock continues; resume only if source still active, no catch-up attacks
lifecycle.safeReturn: same physical bounds throughout; current body/equipment/support retained, no repositioning rescue or restored gear
lifecycle.stacking: one Ascension form per actor; successful newer form replaces older, never adds bonuses twice
